⚠️: These bytes were CARRIED OVER from younissk/lughaty packs/de, not regenerated here. The German source corpora are not on this machine, so the build has not been re-run since the move. The first regeneration must reproduce these checksums or explain why not.

method.frequency: Two passes. Pass 1 ranks surface forms; the lemma table is built from that ranking; pass 2 re-ranks with every surface count summed onto its LEMMA. One pass is wrong in a way that shows immediately — a word's frequency splits across its inflections, so `vergangen`, `eigen` and `zweit` miss the top 10,000 while their inflected forms make it, and 750 entries end up with an unrankable key.
method.lemmatizer: Universal Dependencies treebanks, human-annotated FORM→LEMMA columns, homographs resolved by majority over the corpus. NOT rule-based.
method.lemmatizerWarning: ⚠️ An earlier rule-based version produced silent, plausible errors: warten→waren (to wait→were), Ware→war, Seite→seit, Stärke→stark. Every one passed a both-words-are-common guard. A learner who proved `waren` would have been credited with `warten`. Any future lemmatizer change must be diffed against these files, not merely re-run.
method.filters: Surface forms shorter than 2 characters or outside the pack tokenize pattern are dropped. A form survives only if it appears in more than one corpus or at least 20 times, which removes the OCR and typo tail.

coverageAt10kLemmas.note: ⚠️ ADR-0003 invariant 1 cites ~98% at 8,000 word FAMILIES. That is not this number and the two are not comparable — families are not lemmas, and the corpus and tokenizer are somebody else's. Do not read 88% as a shortfall against 98%.
